canon_ref.note: Morning. Pawn tells Ceria the Hive came ten years ago to make a new kind of Antinium. Ceria can numb Erin's sore throat but cannot cure a cold.

b1.pawn_goes_home_to_the_hive.summary: Erin wakes with a cold. Calruz asks Pawn why he never fought back; Pawn says a Worker's life belongs to the Hive. Erin begs him to stay, but Pawn says he is important now: the Queen will call him once her Rite of Anastases ends. He half lies that staying would bring Soldiers, and goes home.

canon_ref.note: The rest of the day. Toren understands Goblin speech: the dead share one language. Rags comes with about thirty Goblins; five wait outside. Toren is a Level 3 [Skeleton Warrior].

b1.toren_guards_sleeping_erin.summary: Erin sleeps off her cold while Toren blocks the kitchen door, even to Pisces, who made it. Selys screams at it, then pummels Pisces and threatens a twenty-gold bounty if he raises undead near Liscor. Bruised, Rags plays chess against herself until Toren sits down and loses to her game after game.

system.name: Spell [Invisibility]
system.note: Tier 4; a month of study to master.
